_comment: Ad Hoc Session A3 -- built-in starter flag bundles for optimizer.py's --preset flag. Not a config format for user-saved presets (those live in the frontend's cloud-synced preset store, a separate mechanism) -- this file is the CLI's one-shot starting point for the three lineup types Greg builds: Cash, SE/3-Max GPP, and MME GPP (20-150 lineups). Any flag explicitly passed on the command line overrides the matching value here (see main()'s _load_preset_overrides()). lambda values are the validated defaults from Session 10.5b's backtest sweep (DK, 2018-2021, 65 weeks, holdout) -- see optimizer.py's --lambda help text and ROADMAP.md Ad Hoc Session A5. Cash and se_gpp use lambda=0.063, the grid's best value for their own metric (cash beat@p44 +0.006 over 0.0, <1 SE, suggestive not conclusive; se_gpp/3-max beat@p50 also best at 0.063 but no clear winner over 0.0). mme_gpp uses lambda=-0.005, the grid's best value for large-field top@p90, where any positive lambda measurably hurts.
